name: Christmas
description: Christmas word search puzzles made for a calm December evening. Our free online grids lean into evergreen trees, winter lights, cocoa, carols and quiet snow — written for adults and older teens, not for noisy kids apps. Start with an easy puzzle, try a medium grid with diagonals, or settle into a hard puzzle with reverse words. There is no timer and no account required. Bookmark the theme page and return through the season for more Christmas word searches that stay gentle, readable and free of licensed characters.
